from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document for sorting."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The case cause of action explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema for the parsed content of a single judgment document."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
